name: Murooj Al Furjan By Nakheel
paymentPlan: 5% down payment at the sales launch, 35% during construction, and 60%
overview: Step into a world of refined luxury with Murooj Al Furjan, a premium development by Nakheel that redefines contemporary living. These magnificent 4- and 5-bedroom Murooj Al Furjan villas are set amidst the thriving neighborhood of Al Furjan in Dubai, offering an exquisite blend of modern architectural elegance and lush green landscapes.
